lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows and vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of the circular spots, creating a grid-like intersection pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extends along the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition with higher values on the dorsal side and lower values in the ventral shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on the dorsal fin, appearing as a deep V-shaped indentation or amputation on the superior-posterior margin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller high-luminance spots visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
